Entry on 36:20 runs on to ﴿إِنِّي آمَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونَ﴾ (25) as the end of the quoted speech; TR/EN agree.
Entry on ﴿إِلاَّ رَحْمَةً﴾ (44) discusses «فلا صريخ لهم» of 43 as the linked clause; TR/EN agree.
